package.name: rover_io_context
package.description: Shared transport primitives for the rover: the byte-stream / byte-publisher domain ports, the inbound and outbound byte bridges, and the ASIO io_service thread pool that rover_serial_driver and rover_udp_driver run their sockets on. Carries no ROS dependency. Forked from transport_drivers' io_context (v1.2.0); see README.md.
